An academic project for the SMI Master's programme (Entrepreneurship course), Université Paris-Saclay. We study how generative AI is used and governed when writing theses and final projects.

Time: about 10 minutes online or 25–30 minutes in an interview. Responses are anonymous and used only for this academic project. You may stop at any time. There are no right or wrong answers.

Imagine a tool in which students write their thesis. It applies the AI-use rules set by their programme, records each use and automatically generates the required declaration. Teachers see how the text was built (what comes from the student, AI or sources), without a detector or automatic grading.
